hints.title: Fixed Window Size Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain an active window of size k and track element counts within that window.

hints.title: Frequency Counter Update
hints.text: When moving the window forward, decrement the outgoing element count and increment the incoming element count.

hints.title: Distinct Value Cardinality
hints.text: Maintain a running count of keys with positive frequency to record distinct counts in constant time.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def distinctNumbers(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
        freq = defaultdict(int)
        distinct = 0
        ans = []

        for i in range(k):
            if freq[nums[i]] == 0:
                distinct += 1
            freq[nums[i]] += 1
        ans.append(distinct)

        for i in range(k, len(nums)):
            out_val = nums[i - k]
            freq[out_val] -= 1
            if freq[out_val] == 0:
                distinct -= 1

            in_val = nums[i]
            if freq[in_val] == 0:
                distinct += 1
            freq[in_val] += 1

            ans.append(distinct)

        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-evaluating distinct elements from scratch for each window takes O(n * k) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding window with frequency map updates distinct counts in O(1) time per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate manages map insertions and deletions correctly without creating stale zero keys.
